01/17: The deal hit an unexpected obstacle on Friday.  The SVP of procurement (new in role) stated that PFG is at risk going with a 5 year EA, he is asking for an ability to "true down" in years 4 and 5 or change to a 3 year deal.  We responded late on Friday afternoon/evening reinforcing the benefits of value shift and highlighted our divestiture language.  We are also working on a 3 year option albeit not nearly as competitive - just in case it is needed.
01/11: I met with PFG mgmt once again last week.  They are driving to get this through their process before qtr end, but stopped short of making any firm commitments given new mgmt in place and CIO international travel schedule potentially slowing the approval process.  At this point, I would say it is a 50/50 shot.  The client is driving hard to make this happen.
01/05: I met with PFG exec mgmt before we went on holiday break.  They had started their analysis but still had several internal meetings to complete their comparison (BAU vs. EA).  They were shutdown over break and so I will be back in touch early this week.
12/22: Presented proposal last week to client.  The meeting went well, but they need time to validate numbers.  We plan to touch base this week before shutdown, but I am not expecting much movement until after the holiday break.  The prolonged break combined with a recent change in PFG executive leadership poses risk to closing the EA this quarter.
12/06: Customer has not confirmed Nexus numbers.  They have also identified 139 devices currently covered by CX which may need to be removed.  I hope to have both issues flattened next week so we can move to quote stage.  We also identified a way to address EAMP limitation causing us to quote more licenses than needed.  We plan to submit DID on Monday to get reapproved, but it may need to be tweaked if PFG needs to change Nexus or CX coverage.
11/29: DID was not approved in time for Nov 25 mtg so we discussed final quantities.  Customer is pushing back on Nexus and Meraki numbers.  Meeting next week to dig into these two items once again.  Also discussing proposal with WWT to ensure alignment.  Need to get them aligned with LCS - they are resisting as they feel it competes with some of the services that they intend on providing.
11/22: Meeting to present proposal to customer planned for Nov 25, but we are encountering EAMP system issues which may cause meeting to be delayed.
11/18: Plan to have inventory finalized (delisted) and DSA processed this coming week with customer facing mtg on 11/25
10/27: Meeting with PFG this week to finalize inventory and licensing levels.  Depending on how this goes, we plan to get pricing to the client within the next week (two max).
09/03: Discussed with customer.  Partner RFP is still on track to be finalized within 4-6 weeks.  This is required before final pricing and packaging can be complete.
08/22: Customer sent out partner RFP with decision expected within 45-60 days. Once partner is chosen, we will be able to continue EA discussions/packaging.
07/25:  Spoke with customer on 7/24.  RFP is planned to be issued to three partners in Sep timeframe.  This was not budgeted in 2025 so I am moving it to CY1Q26
07/07: Customer has not yet initiated partner RFQ.  This is not expected for an other week or two.  As a result, I moved this to August.
06/28: Customer placed 1 year renewal this week.  They are planning to initiating an EA quote amongst three partners within next few weeks.  This exercise involves a potential partner change which is adding complexity to this deal.
06/23: Due to their DNA and partner branded support contracts expiring on 6/30, the customer has opted to renew these for one additional year.  That said, they are continuing to pursue the EA as this is the best solution long term.  Given this, the probability of closing the deal this fiscal remains low.
06/16: Customer sending out RFQ this week to partner community (Insight, WWT, and EVT).  This 5 year EA will include product software (Catalyst, Meraki, Nexus, ISE and TE) as well as CX.  I have a call in person with PFG on 6/17 to discuss timelines and concerns in greater detail.
